Applications must be submitted online on or before 10-10-2026.
To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section.
Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIM Nagpur to complete the application.
Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details.

Pay the application fee online, if applicable.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Management Nagpur (IIM Nagpur) for hiring eligible candidates for regular administrative positions.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIM Nagpur?
faq.answer: IIM Nagpur has advertised vacancies for the post of Junior Executive – Regular specifically reserved for OBC category candidates in this recruitment cycle.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for Junior Executive?
faq.answer: A total of 1 vacancy has been released for the Junior Executive – Regular (OBC) post under this recruitment notification published by the institute.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online for IIM Nagpur Junior Executive?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application form for the Junior Executive post is 10-10-2026. Candidates must apply before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the minimum educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a Graduation degree with a minimum of 3 years of post-qualification experience in academic or administrative activities. A Master’s degree is preferred.

faq.question: Q6. What is the maximum age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 35 years as on the last date of application. Age relaxations apply according to standard guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary structure for this position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive a regular appointment at the appropriate pay level as per the 7th Pay Commission along with institute allowances.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee has been mentioned in the official notification released by the Indian Institute of Management Nagpur for this position.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for IIM Nagpur Junior Executive?
faq.answer: The selection process involves shortlisting of candidates based on job requirements followed by a personal interview process conducted by the institute.

faq.question: Q10. How can eligible candidates apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible and interested candidates can apply online exclusively through the official IIM Nagpur website by filling out the form before the last date.
